title: Second Reality by Future Crew (pc demo)
summary: A capture of Second Reality, the real-time audiovisual demo by Future Crew first shown at Assembly 1993, recorded from a 486DX2-66 with a Gravis Ultrasound. It showcases the peak of early 1990s PC demoscene techniques.
why: HN points to it as one of the best and most formative early PC demos, a touchstone of demoscene history.

quote.text: It is considered to be one of the best demos created during the early 1990s on the PC
